ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark-grey/black) background constituting approximately 85-90% of the surface area, contrasted with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters making up the remaining 10-15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity punctate pixels are distributed globally across the fluke surface. Dense, contiguous high-intensity geometric clusters are mapped primarily to the distal tips and the continuous trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 125 degrees at the central axis bifurcation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays fine-frequency micro-serrations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular macro-serrations and jagged protrusions resulting in a highly asymmetric profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a long, tapering convex trajectory toward the distal tip. The right lobe exhibits a shorter, truncated trajectory with significant geometric irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel formations (barnacle-type morphology) are concentrated at the distal tips and along the entire trailing edge contour.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant asymmetric truncation and jagged tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge; heavy localized calcified encrustations (sessile barnacle colonies) along the peripheral edges.
